summary: Communist movement of Cambodia led by Pol Pot. It took power in 1975 and ruled until 1979, a period in which perhaps around two million people died from execution, forced labour, hunger and disease.

events.note: Dated from 1968, when its armed uprising began. The communist party it grew from was founded in 1951.

cause: Driven from power in 1979, then fought on in the jungle until its leaders surrendered or were arrested
